fusions.name: Sitting Target
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. A thrown quill deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets within 6 tiles and leaves it [Leaden] for 5 seconds, so blows are harder for it to slip.

fusions.name: Muddied Water
fusions.desc: Churns the ground around you: it deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, strips 12% armour for 6 seconds, slows each by 20% and knocks each back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Preening Bill
fusions.desc: You pick up to 2 conditions off yourself and move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Returned to Sender
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 25% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.
